claimBoundary: Protocol and synthetic scorer plumbing only; no real-data, model-performance, calibration, or deployment claim.

selectivePrediction.thresholdPurpose: fixed interface-pilot operating point; not claimed optimal or deployable
selectivePrediction.confidenceRule: cover non-abstained predictions with confidence greater than or equal to the threshold
selectivePrediction.primaryEndpoint: joint-grounded selective risk at operational coverage
secondaryEndpoints: answer selective risk at operational coverage
AURC normalized over attained maximum coverage

calibration.binning: equal-width [low, high), with confidence 1.0 included in the last bin

uncertainty.fallbackRule: If fewer than 10 independent match groups are eligible, label intervals descriptive/feasibility-only; do not substitute item-wise resampling.
